answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 63898 Country: India Title: Inheritance Question: If husband had bought a house in his life and made his wife owner of that house, will this house come into account for warasat matter among the warsa? Answer ID: 63898 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 536/536/SD=07/1437) If the husband bought the house and gifted it to his wife during his lifetime and gave the house completely in the possession of the wife then as per the Shariah the wife became the owner of the house. And after the death of the husband the heirs of the husband shall get no share in it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
